Flat, abstract art: a generic rounded-rectangle phone with a blank screen and a large friendly '6' badge next to it. No logo, no red, no play triangle, no screenshot, no people. dropped_for_lack_of_source: Availability in Israel: the video makes no claim either way. Israel is on the Android list (yk-availability-iw.txt:35, yk-availability-en.txt:39), but the iPhone/iPad and computer variants were not captured, and setup does not need the claim. The script stays true either way.

'The passcode replaces the multiplication question' and 'a passcode keeps the kids out of settings': nothing says this. The source only says 'the multiplication question OR your custom passcode' (parental-controls-iw:45), and that the question is there to verify an adult (profiles-iw:64). The screen says 'עם שאלת הכפל, או עם הקוד'.
Timer minimum and maximum: only a slider is described (timer-iw:45). No time range is given.

The app's real on-screen Hebrew labels: only the help center's wording is captured. It carries Google's possible-AI-translation note on every page, and the pages disagree (שאלת הכפל / בעיית הכפל / התרגיל בחשבון). The labels are used in quotes with an on-screen footnote in scene 2 and on the end card. The label „לאישור התוכן בעצמך” is quoted as the help center gives it; the video's own words always address parents in the plural.

Whether ads appear in 'approved content only' mode: not captured. So nothing says 'everything they see is what you chose'. The narration says only that you choose videos and channels, and the screen says 'רק מה שאתם בחרתם' (parental-controls-iw:127).
Supervised accounts on regular YouTube in Israel, the age that applies in Israel, and YouTube Premium in Israel: none were captured, and none are mentioned.
Steps to pause search history: the linked article was not captured (parental-controls-iw:243).

Setup flows for the web version and for TVs were not captured, so the video covers the app flows only. The TV parent code (parental-controls-iw:255) is sourced but was left out for length, not for lack of a source.
Any advice on how much screen time is right, or at what age to start: no source, so none is given.

NOTE, not a dropped fact (voice gate): each of the 19 narration lines was rendered in memory exactly as hebrew_tts.py renders a one-line file (ef_dora, speed 0.9, 0.6 s tail, PCM_16 round-trip) and scored with asr_gate.py's Whisper and CER. All 19 pass at CER ≤ 0.05 (worst is 0.043, on L12, where the only error is the homophone ט for ת). No file was written. Narration is 57.3 s including the 0.45 s gaps; with the scene holds and the end card, the cut runs about 62–66 s.

NOTE (voice gate, residuals): the ASR round-trip accepted some sounds that a listener may still hear as wrong. ח in בחיפוש was heard as ה (L11). The r in ארבע was dropped (L09). The m in במרכז blurred (L19). בעצמכם was heard as בעצמם (L07). L05 (לכל), L08 (לחפש) and L15 (בסוף) are clipped fast-speech forms. A native Hebrew listener must approve before anything is published.

NOTE (voice gate, rephrased): these wordings failed the gate and were replaced. The lock wording failed at CER 0.11–0.63 (האפליקציה ננעלת, המסך ננעל, נעולה). The narration now says הצפייה נעצרת (timer-iw:31: the app stops), and the lock itself ('והאפליקציה ננעלת', timer-iw:49) stays on screen. The verbs לחסום and לדווח failed at 0.26–0.63; they became the button names חסימה and דיווח (block-iw:203, flag-iw:37). The hook 'רוצים לתת לילדים...' failed after the PCM_16 round-trip, so it became 'מתקינים לילדים...'. Lines starting with ואז lost the z sound and were rewritten.

NOTE (Phonikud marks used, all hand-placed): meteg U+05BD on לְֽפִי, בְּֽעַצְמְֽכֶם, יְֽכוֹלִים, לְֽהַגְדָּרוֹת, לְֽהַשְׁבִּית, לְֽהַגְבִּיל and בְּֽמֶרְכַּז. Stress U+05AB on יוּ֫טְיוּבּ, קֹ֫דֶם, יֶ֫לֶד, תּ֫וֹכֶן, נֶעֱצֶ֫רֶת, גּ֫וּגֶל and כּוֹתֶ֫בֶת. Kamatz katan U+05C7 in לְכׇל and כׇּל. No '@' respelled lines are needed.
